query: I'm on a remote Linux VM (SSH only, no browser) and want to use membrane to talk to my personal Outlook. I don't have anything installed yet. Walk me through it.
expected_behavior: first login (headless variant): `membrane login --tenant` prints a URL → user opens it on another device → completes with `membrane login complete <code>`
then create the Outlook connection (point at `reference/connections.md`)
notes: Critical for transferability — the install + headless login + connection bootstrap must be reachable from SKILL.md in ≤1 cross-link.
